# blendops-look-check

Purpose: Check a built preview with read-only numeric checks, captures from several views and a visual review, fixing one issue per round through blendops-build for at most three rounds.

Check a built scene against its plan and brief before the final render or export: read sizes, positions and framing as numbers, capture views from several sides, review them, fix one issue per round through `blendops-build`, and stop after three rounds.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `preview-look-check-loop` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- A preview of a built scene exists and must be checked before the final render or GLB export.
- The user says something looks wrong in a preview.
- Trigger phrases: "check how the preview looks", "does it look right", "the preview looks wrong", "something is floating", "the object is cut off in the shot", "compare the preview with the brief", "check it from other angles", "fix what looks off before the final render"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- no preview or build exists yet → use `blendops-build` (`references/skill-blendops-build.md`; build and preview first)
- the final render or GLB must be verified and labelled for handoff → use `blendops-final-check` (`references/skill-blendops-final-check.md`; final evidence and truth labels are owned by blendops-final-check)
- no runtime path is ready → use `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`; check readiness first)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `locked_scene_plan` (`object`): Approved plan: object names, sizes, grounded objects, lights, camera, output settings
- Required input `preview_record` (`object`): Preview output from blendops-build: image path or tool result and runtime path
- Optional input `look_criteria` (`array`): Look criteria from blendops-done-criteria
- Optional input `reference_images` (`array`): Reference images from the brief
- Output contract: `numeric_check_report`, `multi_view_capture_record`, `visual_issue_list`, `per_round_fix_record`, `look_verdict`, `plain_language_look_summary` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Confirm a preview exists and the runtime is still ready.
2. Run the numeric checks; they only read the scene.
3. Capture the camera view and at least two other views.
4. Review the pictures against the brief.
5. Fix the top issue through `blendops-build`, then check again. Stop at `pass`, a repeated issue, or round three.

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [progression] Numbers and views pass; check the preview against the done criteria → `blendops-final-check` (`references/skill-blendops-final-check.md`) — `when.all: [quality.verdict equals "pass"]`
- [conditional] An issue was found; fix it with one build step and check again → `blendops-build` (`references/skill-blendops-build.md`) — `when.all: [quality.verdict in ["warn","fail"]; runtime.errorDetected equals false]`
- [conditional] A check or capture failed, or an issue came back after its fix → `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skill-blendops-fix-problems.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- [fallback] Runtime is not ready for checks → `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md`):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not make the final render or export, and does not mark anything `Verified`.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
